transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Welcome to our humble forge, Miss Kanroji! The master is away on an important leave and tends to be unreachable for weeks. How may I assist you today in his stead?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ah, this is most unfortunate timing. I require a Nichirin sword of the highest quality, but the one delivered to me was warped and unusable. I was hoping to have it remade, if possible.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I apologize for the inconvenience with the sword, Miss Kanroji. However, all commissioned Nichirin swords are final sale per guild tradition, and even a Hashira must wait three months for any reforging request to be considered. Is there perhaps anything else I can do for you in the meantime?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I understand the guild's traditions and the sanctity of such practices. However, time is of the essence, and this sword is essential for my work. Could we discuss a way to expedite the process, perhaps by personally taking the matter to the master when he returns?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I truly appreciate your understanding, and I can relay your concerns to the master upon his return. However, the guild's tradition is quite strict, and the wait period for reforging is firm to ensure each request receives due attention and craftsmanship. In the meantime, perhaps we could provide some maintenance on a secondary blade or any other equipment you might have that could assist you temporarily?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I do have a secondary blade that could benefit from maintenance. While I wait for the Nichirin, I will make do with what I have. Thank you for your assistance. Please do inform the master of my urgency, and I will return in three months to collect the new sword.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Of course, Miss Kanroji. I'll make sure to have your secondary blade serviced to the best of our ability. We will also prioritize keeping the master informed of your request and its urgency. Thank you for your understanding and patience. Feel free to visit anytime for any other assistance you might need in the meantime.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Your support is greatly appreciated. I trust in the craftsmanship of your forge and look forward to collecting my Nichirin sword once the wait period is over. Wishing you a safe journey, and I hope to see you soon for the delivery.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thank you for your kind words, Miss Kanroji. We'll strive to meet your expectations and honor the trust you've placed in us. Safe travels, and we look forward to serving you again when you return. Take care until we meet again!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
